title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments
subtitle: One platform, six perspectives on combustion
summary: Six gaseous-flame investigations share modular hardware. The document presents objectives, instruments and system capabilities alongside selected reference findings.
relevance: Helps identify flame, soot-formation and extinction variables for studying fire-safety phenomena.
limitation: Equipment capability is not an experimental condition. This profile contains no test matrix and does not validate predictions for lunar or Martian gravity.
application: Helps identify quantities to observe when studying detection and combustion limits. Additional evidence is needed to apply this to an operational safety system.
